## Checklist

- [ ] Claims are limited to hardware and paths that actually executed.
- [ ] Compile-only and runtime evidence are distinguished.
- [ ] No models, caches, compiled artifacts, raw traces, credentials, or private data are included.
- [ ] Known limitations and negative results are stated.
- [ ] Links were checked and `git diff --check` passes.
